analysis_contract.boundary: This five-point fixed-protocol curve is a teaching entry for bounded curvature/fit handling only. It is not a converged EOS, equilibrium lattice constant, bulk modulus, pressure fit, elastic tensor, or material-level result.
analysis_contract.mathematical_pass: five successful distinct-volume SCF outputs and c2>0
analysis_contract.volume_formula: V_primitive=det(CELL_PARAMETERS)=a_cubic^3/4 for the explicit fcc primitive cell

bounded_eos_screen.claim_boundary: This five-point fixed-protocol curve is a teaching entry for bounded curvature/fit handling only. It is not a converged EOS, equilibrium lattice constant, bulk modulus, pressure fit, elastic tensor, or material-level result.

dos_x.claim_boundary: This is a real dos.x output from the hash-bound rerun. Its -12 to 16 eV absolute window does not include all four printed NSCF bands, so the final integral is not a total-state count; neither the output nor its plot establishes DOS convergence.

evidence_boundary: The separate rerun establishes real dos.x execution and a real al.dos file. The committed k/smearing screen remains FAIL and the E(V) quadratic result remains a bounded mathematical fit; neither is promoted to G4 or material acceptance.

exploratory_convergence_screen.claim_boundary: Only the named SCF energy/Fermi samples are assessed as an exploratory screen. This cannot establish G4, DOS, EOS, elastic, Fermi-surface, transport, or material-level convergence.

predeclared_assessment.boundary: These are predeclared exploratory teaching thresholds for the named SCF samples, not universal settings, G4 evidence, scientific acceptance, or a DOS, EOS, elastic, Fermi-surface, or material-science criterion.
predeclared_assessment.scope: Exploratory teaching screen for reported SCF total energy per one-atom primitive cell and printed Fermi level only; it is not a G4 acceptance gate.

smearing_probe.comparison: maximum deviation of al-k12-d001 and al-k12-d004 from al-k12-d002

gaussian_dos_like.claim_boundary: A Gaussian-broadened representation of one printed 8x8x8 NSCF eigenvalue sample only; it is distinct from the separate dos.x table and establishes no numerical convergence.
gaussian_dos_like.energy_reference: epsilon_nk minus Fermi energy printed by rerun nscf-full.out
gaussian_dos_like.weight_convention: QE-printed weights are used without renormalization; their 512-point sum is approximately 2 because the non-spin-polarized output carries spin-degenerate weighting.
